x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: CLI tool for the AvatarTalk SDK.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key. Falls back to configured environment variables, dotnet user-secrets, and the optional credential file.

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Override the API base URL.

options.name: --json
options.description: Render structured responses as raw JSON instead of human-readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --output
options.description: Write response content to this file path instead of stdout.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Write one file per returned item when the response contains multiple resources.

commands.name: auth
commands.description: Inspect and manage API credentials used by the generated CLI.

commands.name: set
commands.description: Store an API key in dotnet user-secrets.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show the authentication source order the CLI will use.

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear the API key stored in dotnet user-secrets.

commands.name: create-live-kit-session
commands.description:
Create a LiveKit avatar session
Creates a new LiveKit session for real-time avatar interaction.
Returns session details including a participant token for joining the LiveKit room.

options.name: --avatar
options.description:
Available avatar characters. Each avatar represents a different
person with distinct appearance and demographics.

options.name: --emotion
options.description: Emotion state for the avatar. Controls facial expression during speech.

options.name: --language
options.description:
Language code for text-to-speech. Determines the voice language
and pronunciation used for generating the avatar's speech.

options.name: --input
options.description: Load request JSON from a file path, '-' for stdin, or an inline JSON object/array string.

options.name: --request-json
options.description: Request body as JSON.

options.name: --request-file
options.description: Path to a JSON request file, or '-' for stdin.

commands.name: delete-live-kit-session
commands.description:
Delete a LiveKit avatar session
Terminates an active LiveKit session and releases associated resources.

arguments.name: TASK_ID
arguments.description: The unique task ID of the LiveKit session to delete

commands.name: generate-lightning-video
commands.description:
Generate video after Lightning payment
Generate the avatar video after a Lightning Network invoice has been paid.
Use the invoice from the request-video endpoint.

options.name: --invoice
options.description: The Lightning invoice that has been paid

commands.name: generate-video
commands.description:
Generate avatar video
Generate a lip-synced avatar video from text. The API uses text-to-speech
to create audio and synchronizes avatar lip movements with the generated audio.
Standard requests return a JSON response with video URLs.
Set the stream query parameter to true for streaming MP4 video response.

options.name: --stream
options.description:
When set to "true", returns a streaming MP4 video response instead of JSON.
The response Content-Type will be video/mp4.

options.name: --text
options.description: The text for the avatar to speak. Will be converted to speech using TTS.

options.name: --avatar
options.description:
Available avatar characters. Each avatar represents a different
person with distinct appearance and demographics.

options.name: --emotion
options.description: Emotion state for the avatar. Controls facial expression during speech.

options.name: --language
options.description:
Language code for text-to-speech. Determines the voice language
and pronunciation used for generating the avatar's speech.

options.name: --delayed
options.description:
When true, the request is processed asynchronously.
The response will include a task ID for polling the result.
Specify true/false; presence alone implies true; omit to inherit.
